## Boomerang 概率预估

```text
differential effect of the upper trail: 2^(-8.00)
differential effect of the lower trail: 2^(-8.00)
Total probability = p^2*q^2*r = 2^(-16.00) x 2^(-16.00) x r
2^(-32.00) <= Total probability <= 2^(-32.00)
To compute the accurate value of total probability, r should be evaluated experimentally or using the (F)BCT framework
```
